body: A speech-text model and framework for real-time spoken dialogue that can listen and speak simultaneously.
plain_description: **Build real-time spoken dialogue experiences with Moshi.** It supports interactive voice conversations through a web interface or command-line clients. Run it on a Mac, CPU, or supported GPU backend.
technical_description: Moshi is a speech-text foundation model and full-duplex spoken dialogue framework using the Mimi streaming neural audio codec. The repository provides PyTorch, MLX, and Rust inference stacks, with web and command-line clients. It models user and generated audio streams alongside speech text; the README reports practical latency as low as 200 ms on an L4 GPU.
title: Moshi
